description: Use when you need to inspect a JWT without a key: decoded header and payload, alg, kid, iat/nbf/exp as ISO times and whether it is expired now. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /util/jwt-decode, $0.001 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Decode only: the signature is never verified. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.
